    Bongartz's Lemma 2.4 (a) #

    Fix separating decompositions sd z of all rad P(z). For a point x and a summand R = (sd x)ᵢ, let B be the points connected inside QSet x to the support of R (Bset). If an indecomposable module U supported in B maps irreducibly to a projective P(y), then y ∈ B, or y = x and U ≅ R (lemma24a).
